extras.textures: PBR 2048px: base color, roughness, metallic, normal (baked)
extras.real_size: industrial bulk storage silo, 4 m diameter, approx. 12 m tall
extras.notes: light grey steel shell with dark stiffening rings on a conical hopper bottom with slide gate, yellow handwheel and outlet spout; teal cone roof with manhole, vent filter, level sensor and yellow roof railing; six teal support legs with cross bracing on concrete footings, yellow and dark warning stripes at the leg feet; yellow caged access ladder; white side fill pipe with flanges, clamps and capped inlet; soft baked patina on edges; front = -Y; no moving parts; no text, no numbers

origin.detail: Built procedurally with Blender scripts. The scripts were written with the help of an AI coding assistant. No generative AI model produced the geometry or textures directly.
